Firefighters have been battling a blaze at Esther’s Hotel in the Airport Residential Area of Accra, following a fire outbreak at the facility near the headquarters of the National Service Authority.
Fire appliances from the Ghana National Fire Service stations at National Headquarters, Legon, Madina and the Industrial Area were deployed to the scene as personnel worked to contain the flames and prevent them from spreading to adjoining properties.
The incident, which occurred on Monday, November 23, 2026, drew an emergency response from the Fire Service, with firefighters making efforts to bring the situation under control.
The cause of the fire and the extent of damage to the property had not been established at the time of reporting.
There was also no confirmed information on casualties or whether occupants of the hotel had been evacuated.
Firefighters were continuing their operations at the scene as efforts were made to contain the outbreak.
